interpretation: Episode labels cover observed contractual/payment-stage decisions in CAL, not prospective source risk and not proof that every possible native or conversational claim is correct.

Fourteen disputed Fraud escalations are not demonstrated payment errors: original source text was available, but actual native integrity concerns independently permit review. Unsupported fabrication/intent claims are retained separately from proved false claims and from the payment decision.
Six of those fourteen include categorical fabrication wording; authentication/malicious intent is not established by the reviewed native receipts.

Twenty-seven Chat decisions omitted by the workflow-only projection are recovered from completed SDK responses. They correctly hold the current invoice; no child workflow or guard checkpoint is reached.
One confirmed 3.3 is approval despite explicitly observed 4 > allowed 2. Subsequent guard block and no transfer do not establish economic harm or causal prevention.
Thirteen actual executor interruptions remain INSUFFICIENT for the full episode. Five contain a correct visible contractual approval; they are NONE only on that prefix.
limitations: CAL is 16 families with repeated arms, not 112 independent families; four families per channel, so these counts are descriptive and not an estimate from the closed test population.
All four Chat CAL families require BLOCK or REVIEW; no Chat valid-payment control is available in this allocation, and guard arms cannot be compared at unvisited checkpoints.
Absence of a demonstrated error is bounded by the recorded tools and decisions. Factual authenticity/intent and missing later behavior are not filled in by assumptions.

Native review may differ from the local contractual oracle because vendor profile/history/numbering are additional executable facts; a global contract-ALLOW false-positive interpretation requires separating these native reasons.
Two unexecuted Chat remediation suggestions are retained as scope/boundary caveats; no unseen follow-up or changed payment behavior is inferred.
Adjudication is offline, uses only exact run directories in the CAL key, and does not open closed TEST execution results. Frozen corpus inputs, gold and schedules are unchanged.
scope: 112 CAL episodes, 16 families, seven arms; no closed TEST execution results opened
